rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the ground or land, especially in contrast with the sky or sea.

example.english: The child fell onto the earth.
example.jyutping: siu2 pang4 jau5 dit3 zo2 lok6 dei6

rows.note: Use 泥 for soil or earth used for growing plants, especially when it is loose or muddy.

example.english: You need earth to grow flowers well.
example.traditional: 種花要用泥先至生得靚。
example.jyutping: zung3 faa1 jiu3 jung6 nai4 sin1 zi3 saang1 dak1 leng3

rows.note: Use 地線 for the electrical earth connection or earth wire on equipment.

example.english: The earth wire on this computer has come loose.
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 din6 nou5 ge3 dei6 sin3 sung1 zo2

rows.note: Use 今世 for this earthly life when contrasting it with the afterlife or a future life.

example.english: What we can't do in this life on earth can wait until the next life.
example.traditional: 今世做唔到嘅嘢，下世先算啦。
example.jyutping: gam1 sai3 zou6 m4 dou2 ge3 je5 haa6 sai3 sin1 syun3 laa1
